# Vendored QR scanner

- Package: `html5-qrcode`
- Version: `2.3.8`
- Source: [official npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/html5-qrcode) from [mebjas/html5-qrcode](https://github.com/mebjas/html5-qrcode)
- Distribution file: `html5-qrcode-2.3.8.min.js` (the package's `html5-qrcode.min.js`)
- License: Apache-2.0; see `html5-qrcode-LICENSE.txt`.

The minified browser bundle is loaded locally by `assets/js/qr-scanner-loader.js` so the scanner does not depend on a public CDN at runtime.
